title: Correct F_BC value
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) must be 20 N (or equivalent with units).

title: Correct mass m value
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must be 2.5 kg (or equivalent with units).

title: Correct force F value
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must be 16 N (or equivalent with units).

title: Horizontal force balance at C
description: Important: The solution must apply horizontal equilibrium at point C, relating tensions in AC and BC using the given angles.

title: Vertical force balance at C
description: Important: The solution must apply vertical equilibrium at point C to solve for the mass m, involving both tension components and weight.

title: Tension in AC from mass M
description: Important: The solution must correctly state that the tension in string segment AC is equal to M*g (15 N) due to the equilibrium of mass M.

title: Analysis for minimum force F
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must recognize that with B' at C's height, the tension in BC becomes horizontal, and the vertical balance requires calculating an applied force F.

title: Direction of applied force
description: Optional: For part (3), the solution should state that the applied force F is directed vertically upward.

title: Sign error in vertical balance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the vertical force equation for part (2) or (3) has incorrect signs for tension components or weight.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the trigonometric functions (sine/cosine) are applied to the wrong angles (e.g., using 53° where 37° is needed) without correction.
